C3.desc: an error of the payment service leaves the function, and the stock stays reserved

C4.desc: the stock is not released when the charge is refused

C5.desc: the charge is not refunded when the booking fails

C6.desc: the refund is for the quantity, not the amount

C7.desc: a booking that raises is tried a second time

C8.desc: stock that was never reserved is released

C9.desc: refactoring: the reservation tests for "refused" instead of "ok"
